narr: Heavy rain fell for the second day in a row around the Mayhill area causing a highway to be closed as monsoon moisture remained in place trapped under an upper level high. Slow moving storms dropped about another inch and a half of rain in the same area which received significant rain the previous day.
ev: Highway 130 south of Mayhill was closed due to flooding crossing the roadway.
lsr: SPOTTER RELAYED INFORMATION FROM FIRE DEPT DISPATCH THAT HWY 130 IS BEING CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING.
